findings.title: Loot pill-drop branch bypasses the dormant-family scope gate
findings.attack_class: consumer seam missing a scope gate (latent channel breach)
findings.reproduction: tests/lab/betaScopeSeams.test.ts > 'SLEEPER: a pill-kind drop of a dormant family mints the dormant pill' — register enemy template with signature drop {kind:'pill', itemId:'phi_van_dan_qi_refining', chance:1}, enemySystem.spawn it, lootSystem.setSession(receiver, player), processDefeatedEnemies([dead entity]) → dormant pill lands in live pillBag. FAILS with: expected ['phi_van_dan_qi_refining'] to not include 'phi_van_dan_qi_refining'. Root cause: pill branch checks only isBreakthroughAcquisitionEnabled(pill.breakthroughRealmId) which returns true for undefined; dormant-family tiered pills carry no breakthroughRealmId. Sibling material branch has three gates (breakthrough realm ~L570, pull-token ~L577, domain-scoped ~L586). Latent: zero authored kind:'pill' drops in src/data at this commit; a minted pill is still hidden by bag surfaces and rejected by usePill.

findings.title: survive.extraSources binds the pre-gate runtime in resolveCombatBuild
findings.reproduction: Static: extraSources reads runtime?.buildSurviveSources (ungated runtime) while every other runtime emit flows through gatedRuntime (undefined when !wayAdmitted). Dead at this commit — CultivationPathRegistry.ts:495 'Beta: no buildSurviveSources', no runtime implements the facet.
